data.explanation: This is a repair invoice from a glazier for fixing a broken living-room window. The full amount of €396.27 is due within 14 days of the invoice date, with no deduction allowed. Make sure the glazier's bank details are used and pay by the deadline shown to avoid a reminder or late fee. Keep the invoice, since craftsman services for your home (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be partly deducted from your taxes — check with a tax advisor if unsure how to claim it.
data.tax_note: Craftsman/repair services performed in the home (Handwerkerleistungen) are tax-deductible under §35a EStG; keep this invoice and proof of bank transfer for the tax return.
